name: Dharma Decision Media Asset Manifest
description: Records all cinematic visual, video, dialogue audio, and ambient sound assets mapped to Mahabharata and Modern Dilemma scenes.

assets.title: Kurukshetra at Dawn
assets.description: Panoramic view of Kurukshetra plain at dawn with assembled Pandava and Kaurava armies, golden chariot in distance.

assets.title: The Chariot Between the Two Hosts
assets.description: Lord Krishna steering the four white horses of the golden chariot into the no-man's land between the two armies.

assets.title: Arjuna Seeing Bhishma and Drona
assets.description: Arjuna looking across the lines at revered patriarch Bhishma in white armor and master teacher Drona.

assets.title: Arjuna Lowers the Gandiva Bow
assets.description: Arjuna sinking to the chariot floor in moral agony, dropping his divine bow Gandiva before battle.

assets.title: Krishna's Divine Counsel (Gitopadesha)
assets.description: Lord Krishna turning to impart transcendent wisdom and ethical clarity to the conflicted warrior.

assets.title: Arjuna's Resolute Stand
assets.description: Arjuna rising with Gandiva drawn, accepting his kshatriya duty with unwavering moral focus.

assets.title: The War Council of the Pandavas
assets.description: Pandava brothers and Krishna strategizing around a tactical map table illuminated by brass oil lamps at night.

assets.title: The Assembly Hall of Hastinapura
assets.description: Carved stone columns and grand marble throne of Hastinapura where diplomatic peace envoys are received.

assets.title: Bhishma on the Bed of Arrows
assets.description: The tenth sunset of Kurukshetra where Grandfather Bhishma rests upon the bed of arrows as heroes pay homage.

assets.title: The Sacred Aftermath at Sunset
assets.description: A scarlet and indigo sunset over the quiet battlefield with broken chariot wheels and a solitary chariot in silhouette.

assets.title: College Corridor Ragging Dilemma
assets.description: College campus hallway with senior students confronting a vulnerable freshman near lockers.

assets.title: Late Night Group Project Crisis
assets.description: University study room at 11:45 PM with student teammates, laptops, deadline whiteboard, and an empty chair.

audio.engine: WebAudio Layered Synthesizer + SpeechSynthesis Voice Fallback
